books.title: Merlin in the Machine
books.author: Ryan Allen
books.premise: A new novel: the owners copy Merlin into the intelligence inside everything, and the real Merlin helps Perceval and Blanchefleur free his copy.
books.outsideReason: A new novel set in a future long after the legend, where "Arthur remains the remembered king Merlin once advised", as the ticket's opening says; it tells no part of the story's own time
